overseer-judge raw --input <path|-> [flags]

send an arbitrary Jev request read from --input

Output: the System One response as one JSON object.

Flags:
  -dry-run
    	print the request that would be sent and exit 0
  -input string
    	request JSON to send; - reads stdin (required)
  -log-level string
    	stderr diagnostics: debug, info, warn, error (default "warn")
  -model string
    	Jev model (default from TYPESAFE_DEFAULT_MODEL)
  -pretty
    	indent JSON output
  -timeout duration
    	timeout for each HTTP attempt (default 10s)

Example:
  printf '%s' '{"state":"Payouts have failed for 3 days.",
    "questions":{"urgent":{"type":"noul",
    "instructions":"Does this convey urgency?"}}}' |
    overseer-judge raw --input - --pretty
